title: Grusch's 'alternative timeline' view of the technology
place_text: Jesse Michels's interview with David Grusch

tellings.quote: he said if I were a betting man I think that this represents tech that is not a step-wise leap ahead of humanity but it's almost an alternative timeline in which they

plain: The recovered craft, the whistleblower David Grusch told Michels, may not be technology just a step ahead of ours but something more like the product of an alternative timeline. Grusch is a former intelligence officer who says the government holds crashed non-human craft, and Michels recalls the remark from his 2023 interview with him, retelling it in a later episode with a Navy pilot. If true, the makers would not simply be more advanced, but on a whole different path.
